app.title: Intelligent Spray — Interactive Demo
app.footer: Intelligent Spray demo · runs entirely client-side, no data leaves your browser
combine.heading: Combine — Build a Recipe
combine.step2: 2. Find a contour to use as the feature region
combine.featureAndPath: Feature region + {pathLabel} path from contour #{index} ({w}×{h} px)
combine.contourEmpty: No contours found yet - click "Find contours".
combine.statusCvLoading: OpenCV.js is still loading, please wait.
combine.statusContoursFound: {count} contour(s) found - largest one auto-selected as the feature region. Pick a different row to change it.
combine.statusNoContours: No contours found - try a lower or higher threshold.
combine.statusPhotoLoaded: Loaded your photo. Previous paths and feature region were cleared - place them again on the new photo.
combine.statusNeedPath: Place at least one path before saving.
prerun.heading: Pre-run — Match & Correct
prerun.simulateLabel: Simulate the workpiece shifting (ground truth — hidden until you reveal it)
prerun.featureNoRegion: Recipe has no feature region - matching will fail
prerun.matchRecipeLoaded: Recipe loaded. Generate or upload a current photo, then run the match.
prerun.matchSimGenerated: Simulated current photo generated (the photo above now shows the nudged version). Run the match to measure the deviation.
prerun.matchUploaded: Uploaded photo ready (the photo above now shows it - no ground truth available for a real photo). Run the match.
prerun.cvLoadingInitial: Loading OpenCV.js (WebAssembly, ~10 MB) - this can take a few seconds on first load...
prerun.cvReady: OpenCV.js ready. Load a recipe, generate or upload a current photo, then run the match.
prerun.matchNoFeatureRegion: This recipe has no feature region.
prerun.matchTooFewFeatures: Not enough distinctive features found - try a smaller, more detailed feature region.
prerun.matchTooFewMatches: Too few good matches ({count}) to compute a reliable transform.
prerun.matchLowConfidence: Match confidence too low (inliers {inliers}, score {score}). Try a more distinctive feature region.
prerun.matchNeedPath: Load a recipe with at least one path first.
prerun.matchApplied: Match applied to the saved path.
prerun.matchConfirmed: Path confirmed with no adjustment - use only when you are certain the workpiece has not moved.
prerun.groundDialedIn: You dialed in: shift ({sx}, {sy}) px, rotate {rot} deg.
prerun.groundExpected: Expected measured translation about the image origin: ({tx}, {ty}) px
prerun.groundExpectedNote: - differs from the raw shift because rotation is measured about the origin, the same convention the production system uses.

sim.statusInitial: Apply a matched or confirmed path above to enable simulation.
sim.statusReady: Ready - press Play to simulate the spray pass.
sim.statusTooFew: This path has too few points to simulate.
